d:
Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some money for a hotel so that her Uncle Ron can stay in his
flat, but Mr Bean decides to keep the money and hide in his wardrobe overnight. He
makes himself comfortable among the clothes, but starts to get hungry as he watches
Ron eating, and can’t resist sneaking out. Can Mr Bean keep himself hidden all night,
especially when he needs the toilet?
Welcome to the official YouTube home of Mr Bean, the legendary comedy icon loved across the globe! Step into a world of hilarious mishaps, quirky problem-solving, and unforgettable moments that have entertained generations.
